tools.name: plan_game_night
tools.description: Use this when someone is planning an evening or event with games: game night, house party, birthday, family night, kids, a couple, an office or team event, or friends in different cities. Builds an ordered PadConsole playlist (warm-up, main games, finale) that fits the group size, the occasion and t

tools.name: recommend_games
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what to do or play at home with a number of friends ("we are 4 friends at home, what can we do?", "what can 2 people play at home?", "6 friends, how do we have a good time?"), with family or kids, games for the TV without a console, party games where phones are controllers

tools.name: search_games
tools.description: Use this when someone asks for a kind of game by theme or keyword rather than by group size, for example football, racing, fighting, horror, quiz or trivia, bluffing, impostor, drawing, dance or motion, zombies, pirates, music. Returns matching PadConsole games with links. Does not start a game.

tools.name: get_game_details
tools.description: Use this when someone asks about one specific PadConsole game (player count, genre, what it is like, whether friends in other homes can join). Takes a game id returned by another tool or a title. Returns a description and a link to the game page.

tools.name: explain_how_it_works
tools.description: Use this when someone asks how to start, what equipment or devices are needed (TV, laptop, phones, camera), or how friends in different homes can play together. Returns the steps and the link to open.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "recommend_games" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use this when someone asks what to play with friends, family or kids at home, games for the TV without a console, party games where phones are controllers, or games to play with friends far away. Given the number of players (and optionally the mood), returns up to 8 matching PadConsole games with pl" → after: "Use this when someone asks what to do or play at home with a number of friends ("we are 4 friends at home, what can we do?", "what can 2 people play at home?", "6 friends, how do we have a good time?"), with family or kids, games for the TV without a console, party games where phones are controllers"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
